ownership: IMPERIA CW — Cold War: startup war, cartel initialization and equilibrium launcher fixes

arab_coalition.cause: Palestine joined Egypt's war but was omitted from Egypt's faction despite starting fully occupied.
arab_coalition.fix: Add Palestine to the Arab Joint Defense Command before Egypt's declaration; retain the existing add_to_war targeting Egypt against Israel.
preserved: Palestinian ownership of West Bank and Gaza

cartels.cause: All 28 startup cartel countries were activated in 1970, but their strength and influence were defined only in dated 2000 history. Unset values satisfied the defeat thresholds.
cartels.fix: Initialize missing 1970 stocks from native country-specific baselines before penalty calculation. Require both stocks to exist before declaring victory.
cartels.independent_review: Passed; all 28 profiles, startup order, native variable existence semantics and final-victory guards reviewed.

equilibrium_launcher.fix: Use the native lower global-status area, right-anchored at (-210, 88), with the original 56 by 26 button.
checks: Eight logical UI widths from 1280 to 2560
Army, navy and air overview controls

performance: No new daily or monthly country loops. Cartel initialization reuses the existing startup pass; faction membership is set during existing world setup; launcher behavior and dirty updates are unchanged.
save_compatibility: Use a fresh 1970 start to verify the starting war and cartel initialization. Existing completed peace settlements and cartel victories are not reversed.
